title: ATB Event v1
description: Canonical ATB event object used for hash computation and verification.
$comment: Reader safety limits: 16,777,216 bytes per NDJSON record, 536,870,912 total bytes, and 1,000,000 non-empty records by default. See docs/specification/bundle-v1.md §2.3.

atb.bundle.manifest.description: Reserved system type. Must be the first record in a bundle and uses seq 0.
atb.bundle.manifest.$comment: The manifest data payload has two supported shapes selected by manifest version. v1 (the writer default for maximum compatibility) wraps the manifest fields as a JSON-encoded string in event.data — readers must json-decode data a second time. This double-encoding is historical, not a deliberate design choice; it is preserved so existing bundles re-verify byte-for-byte. v2 stores the manifest as a structured JSON object directly in event.data. Both forms hash with the same RFC 8785 canonicaliser as any other event; the difference is only in what data contains. See docs/specification/bundle-v1.md §3.1.

oneOf.description: v1 manifest: JSON-encoded string containing manifest fields (version, bundle_id, created_at). Must be JSON-decoded a second time.

atb.bundle.anchor.description: TSA anchor record. Written after a successful RFC 3161 timestamp request. Reserved system type; appended after the bundle snapshot it anchors, so it uses the next normal event sequence rather than seq 0. The data payload is written as a JSON string with these fields.

atb.bundle.signature.description: Bundle signature record. Written after signing the pre-sign bundle NDJSON bytes. Reserved system type; appended after the bundle snapshot it signs, so it uses the next normal event sequence rather than seq 0.

signature.description: Base64-encoded signature over the raw 32-byte bundle hash. Encoding depends on algorithm: raw 64 bytes for ed25519, ASN.1 DER (r,s) for ecdsa-p256.

pubkey.description: Base64-encoded public key. For ed25519, the raw 32-byte key. For ecdsa-p256, either a PKIX DER blob or a 65-byte uncompressed point (0x04 || X || Y).

algorithm.description: Signing algorithm. Absent or empty implies ed25519 for backward compatibility.

key_id.description: Optional backend-scoped key identifier. Empty or absent for implicit local signatures.

backend.description: Optional signing backend label, such as local, https-http, aws-kms, gcp-kms, vault, or local:fallback:<backend>.

signed_at.description: Optional RFC 3339 timestamp of the signing operation.

atb.snapshot.description: Named bundle checkpoint appended by atb snapshot. Optional human oversight attribution fields support EU AI Act Article 14 evidence.

actor_id.description: Optional EU AI Act Article 14 human oversight attribution: identifier of the human approver or reviewer.

actor_role.description: Optional EU AI Act Article 14 human oversight attribution: role of the human approver or reviewer.

oversight_note.description: Optional EU AI Act Article 14 human oversight attribution: human rationale or review note captured with the snapshot.

documented_event_types.$comment: Non-normative catalogue of event types emitted by the ATB Go runtime, CLI, and SDKs. The canonical type field remains an open dot-namespaced string (see properties.type); this block documents the shape readers and downstream tooling can expect for each known type. Property lists are illustrative, not exhaustive: writers may include additional fields (digests, source_role, source_line_num, request_id) that aid traceability without changing the canonical hash contract.

ai.request.received.description: AI request received at the application boundary. Emitted by the runtime and by atb import chatlog when mapping a user turn.

request_id.description: Stable identifier for the request, used to correlate downstream model and tool events.

actor_id_hash.description: Hashed actor identifier for privacy-preserving attribution.

purpose_tag.description: Purpose tag describing why the request was made.

input_digest.description: SHA-256 digest of the request input, in hex.

input_format.description: Format identifier for the request input, such as text or json.

ai.response.sent.description: AI response sent from the application boundary. Emitted alongside model output when a response is returned to the caller.

output_digest.description: SHA-256 digest of the response output, in hex.

ai.llm.call.description: Canonical LLM lifecycle event used by integrations that prefer a single call-shaped record over the model_invoked and model_output pair.

ai.tool.exec.description: Tool execution lifecycle event. Emitted by the runtime, by gate integrations, and by atb import chatlog when mapping a tool turn.

tool_name.description: Name of the tool that was called.

tool_args.description: Decoded tool arguments as a JSON value when available.

tool_args_digest.description: SHA-256 digest of the canonical tool arguments.

tool_output.description: Tool output content captured as text. Optional; readers should fall back to tool_output_digest when absent.

tool_output_digest.description: SHA-256 digest of the tool output.

ai.tool.exec.$comment: Canonical integration envelope carries tool_name inside data.context.tool_name; no top-level required fields are declared for ai.tool.exec.

ai.chain.run.description: Chain or step lifecycle event used by orchestration integrations such as LangChain.

ai.policy.decision.description: Policy engine decision (allow or deny) over a candidate action or response. May carry policy_signature, policy_signer_pubkey, policy_doc_hash, and policy_doc_signature fields when the decision is signed.

ai.retrieval.executed.description: Retrieval step executed during a RAG pipeline.

ai.model.invoked.description: LLM invocation sent. Emitted by the runtime and by atb import chatlog when mapping an assistant turn that names a model.

model_id.description: Model identifier as reported by the provider.

model_provider.description: Provider that served the model invocation, such as anthropic, openai, or google.

model_parameters_digest.description: SHA-256 digest of the canonicalised invocation parameters.

prompt_digest.description: SHA-256 digest of the canonicalised prompt.

ai.model.output.description: LLM output received. Companion to ai.model.invoked.

ai.action.precommit.description: Pre-commit record for a gated privileged action. Written before the action is executed.

principal.description: Optional acting-principal attribution. Distinguishes who initiated the action (an autonomous agent, a human, or a tool) and, when an agent acts for a person, on whose behalf — the identity/permission gap behind agent incidents.

on_behalf_of.description: Hashed identifier of the principal this action is taken for, when delegated.

ai.action.executed.description: Privileged action executed through the action gate.

effective_scope.description: Optional permission scope, role, or grant the action actually ran under. Records the access context behind privileged-action incidents (e.g. an agent executing with broader-than-expected operator permissions).

ai.action.committed.description: Privileged action committed to its downstream sink.

ai.action.error.description: Privileged action attempted but did not succeed (failed, blocked, timed out, or denied at the sink). Forensic counterpart to the success-shaped ai.action.executed.

ai.human.approval.description: Human approval of an action or override.

ai.job.scheduled.description: Background job scheduled for asynchronous execution.

ai.job.started.description: Background job started by a worker.

ai.job.step.description: Individual step recorded within a background job run.

ai.job.completed.description: Background job completed, successfully or otherwise.

data.export.precommit.description: Pre-commit record for a data export. Written before the export is executed.

data.export.executed.description: Data export executed to its downstream sink.

data.export.error.description: Data export attempted but did not succeed. Forensic counterpart to data.export.executed, mirroring ai.action.error.

data.retention.policy_set.description: A deployment retention policy was configured for the first time. ATB records the operator-visible policy but does not enforce storage-system retention by itself.

data.retention.policy_changed.description: An existing deployment retention policy was changed. Digests link the previous and replacement configurations without embedding unrelated local configuration.

data.retention.enforced.description: Evidence that a retention-relevant operation completed or a remote retention request was accepted. The independently_verified field prevents API acceptance from being represented as proof of storage-side enforcement.

atb.corroboration.external.description: External corroboration record retrieved by an adapter from a third-party system.

atb.event.rag_index.description: PageIndex document tree build record. Carries an index_hash and node_count summarising the indexed corpus.

atb.event.rag_retrieval.description: PageIndex reasoning-based retrieval result. Carries node_id and page_start/page_end identifying the retrieved span.

dev.session.description: Developer session marker used by tooling and tests.

atb.tool.call.description: Tool invocation recorded for session oversight. Emitted by the SDK oversight emitters and by atb intercept session capture.

session_id.description: Session identifier the tool call belongs to.

actor_id.description: Optional actor reference for the invocation.

tool_input_digest.description: SHA-256 hex of the canonicalised tool input.

tool_output_digest.description: SHA-256 hex of the canonicalised tool output.

atb.data.export.description: Data export recorded outside the session boundary.

session_id.description: Session identifier the export belongs to.

export_target.description: Identifier of the export destination (URI, system, or sink name).

actor_id.description: Optional actor reference for the export.

atb.human.override.description: Human operator overrode an AI-recommended action.

session_id.description: Session identifier the override belongs to.

actor_id.description: Optional canonical identifier of the human operator.

overridden_action_id.description: Optional identifier of the overridden action.

atb.human.approval.description: Human operator approved a pending action. When recorded in sequence before a corresponding atb.tool.call in the same session, it closes the tool_without_approval anomaly flag.

session_id.description: Session identifier the approval belongs to.

approved_action_id.description: Identifier of the action being approved.

actor_id.description: Optional canonical identifier of the approving operator.

atb.session.close.description: Capture session closed. Proxy-internal lifecycle marker emitted by atb intercept on session teardown.
atb.session.close.$comment: Beyond the required fields the proxy always emits the always-emitted fields below; they are additive under the manifest v1 contract and readers MUST NOT require them. See docs/specification/events.md and internal/proxy/session.go SessionCloseRecord.

session_id.description: Stable identifier of the closed capture session.

actor_id.description: Canonical actor reference for the session; empty string when unresolved.

model.description: Always-emitted: last model observed on the session; empty string when none seen.

exchange_count.description: Always-emitted: number of request/response exchanges captured in the session.

total_tokens.description: Always-emitted: summed prompt and output tokens across the session, when reported by the model.

closed_at.description: Always-emitted: RFC 3339 timestamp the session was closed.

atb.exchange.complete.description: Request/response exchange completed within a capture session. Proxy-internal; consumed by the session index to count exchanges per session.
atb.exchange.complete.$comment: Beyond the required fields the proxy always emits actor_id, completed_at, and tool_calls_count, and emits model/input_tokens/output_tokens/latency_ms when known. All are additive under the manifest v1 contract and readers MUST NOT require them. See docs/specification/events.md and internal/proxy/session.go ExchangeCompleteRecord.

session_id.description: Session identifier the exchange belongs to.

exchange_id.description: Stable identifier of the completed exchange.

request_event_id.description: Hash of the originating proxy request record.

actor_id.description: Always-emitted: resolved actor identity; empty string when unresolvable.

completed_at.description: Always-emitted: RFC 3339 timestamp of response completion.

tool_calls_count.description: Always-emitted: tool/function invocations counted in the response body; 0 when none or when the body is not recognised.

model.description: Optional: model identifier from the proxied response, when known.

input_tokens.description: Optional: token count from the request, when reported by the model.

output_tokens.description: Optional: token count from the response, when reported by the model.

latency_ms.description: Optional: wall-clock milliseconds from request arrival to response flush.

atb.capture.scope.description: Capture-coverage attestation written by atb intercept at startup. Makes the bundle self-describing about what the recorder could and could not observe, so absence of an event is evidence of scope rather than of an event that did not occur.

targets.description: Upstream provider hosts captured by the proxy.

capture_mode.description: digest: only body_sha256 + byte length recorded; raw: full bodies retained (--capture-bodies).

header_policy.description: Only explicitly listed non-secret headers are recorded.

recorded_headers.description: Header names eligible for evidence capture; all other headers are omitted.

out_of_scope.description: Plain statement of what this recorder does not see (e.g. provider traffic that bypasses the proxy).

atb.capture.rejected.description: Privacy-safe evidence that a proxied request or response was rejected or could not be captured completely.

observed_bytes.description: Bytes observed before rejection; for oversized streams this is a lower bound.

atb.llm.request.description: Captured upstream LLM API request. Proxy-internal; emitted by atb intercept for each request through the capture proxy.
atb.llm.request.$comment: Body content is recorded as a SHA-256 digest (body_sha256) and byte length (body_bytes) by default; the raw body is included only under atb intercept --capture-bodies. Only the conservative non-secret header allowlist declared by atb.capture.scope is eligible for recording. See internal/proxy/types.go RequestRecord.ToEvent.

session_id.description: Capture session the request belongs to.

method.description: HTTP method of the captured request.

path.description: Request path on the upstream host.

model.description: Optional: model identifier parsed from the request body.

body_sha256.description: SHA-256 digest of the request body; absent when the body is empty.

body_bytes.description: Byte length of the request body.

body.description: Raw request body; present only under --capture-bodies.

atb.llm.response.description: Captured upstream LLM API response. Proxy-internal; emitted by atb intercept for each response through the capture proxy.
atb.llm.response.$comment: Body content is recorded as a SHA-256 digest (body_sha256) and byte length (body_bytes) by default; the raw body is included only under atb intercept --capture-bodies. Credential and session-secret headers are stripped before recording. See internal/proxy/types.go ResponseRecord.ToEvent.

session_id.description: Capture session the response belongs to.

method.description: HTTP method of the originating request.

path.description: Request path on the upstream host.

status_code.description: HTTP status code returned by the upstream provider.

model.description: Optional: model identifier parsed from the response or session.

body_sha256.description: SHA-256 digest of the response body; absent when the body is empty.

body_bytes.description: Byte length of the response body.

usage.description: Optional: token usage {prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens} when reported by the model.

body.description: Raw response body; present only under --capture-bodies.

identity_evidence.description: Caller-provided reviewer or operator identity evidence. ATB preserves this object in the hash chain but does not independently verify the asserted identity.

event_types.description: Bundle manifest (seq 0, always first in a new bundle)
AI request received at app boundary
AI response sent from app boundary
Canonical LLM lifecycle event for integrations
Canonical tool execution lifecycle event for integrations
Canonical chain or step lifecycle event for integrations
Pre-commit record for a gated privileged action
Privileged action attempted but did not succeed (failed, blocked, timed out, or denied at the sink)
event_types.$comment: Forensic record of a non-success execution outcome, distinct from the success-shaped ai.action.executed. error_class is one of: failed, blocked, timeout, exception, denied_at_sink. Optional error_detail_digest carries a privacy-safe hash of the failure detail. Not yet bound to an obligation profile; populated by capture and surfaced in incident reconstruction.

event_types.description: Human approval of an action or override
Individual step within a background job
Pre-commit record for a data export
Data export attempted but did not succeed (failed, blocked, timed out, or denied at the sink)
event_types.$comment: Forensic counterpart to data.export.executed, mirroring ai.action.error. error_class is one of: failed, blocked, timeout, exception, denied_at_sink. Optional error_detail_digest carries a privacy-safe hash of the failure detail. Not bound to an obligation profile; emitted by the data-export gate on failure.

event_types.description: Retention-relevant local operation completed or remote retention request accepted
PageIndex document tree build record (index_hash, node_count)
Tool invocation recorded for session oversight
Human operator overrode an AI-recommended action
Human operator approved a pending action
Capture-coverage attestation written by atb intercept at startup: what the recorder can and cannot see
Request/response exchange completed within a capture session (proxy-internal)

seq.description: Sequence number of this event within the bundle. 0 is reserved for the bundle manifest record.

prev_hash.description: Hex-encoded SHA-256 hash of the previous event, or 64 zeros (genesis sentinel) for the first event.

type.description: Dot-namespaced event type identifier. Reserved system types include atb.bundle.manifest and atb.bundle.anchor.

hash_algo.description: Hash algorithm used to compute this event's hash.

actor_id.description: Optional caller-asserted actor attribution context. Preserved by the hash chain after recording.

org_id.description: Optional caller-asserted organisation attribution context. Preserved by the hash chain after recording.

workspace_id.description: Optional caller-asserted workspace attribution context. Preserved by the hash chain after recording.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp of event creation. When present, included in the canonical hash.

parent_span_id.description: W3C trace context parent span identifier.
